answer: Randomized Slot Lantern. Each round a public verifiable random function assigns agents to a hidden checkpoint, revealed only after commitments lock. Duplicate identities cannot predict which node they must reach before the beacon fires. A sybil cluster must staff every candidate checkpoint to guarantee coverage, paying full operating cost per copy at each zenith of the schedule. Missed assignments forfeit that round's reward, so unstaffed duplicates decay. The horizon of profitable duplication shrinks as checkpoint count grows.
